source_title: SBI Real-Time Xpress Credit Official Portal
raw_quote: Personal loan scheme: Real-Time Xpress Credit (RTXC) for salaried individuals.
Unsecured personal loan for personal use except speculative/capital market activities.
No collateral security or third-party guarantor required for eligible salary package holders.
Applicant must maintain a Salary Package Account with State Bank of India.
The applicant must be an Indian National. NRI/PIO/OCI are not eligible.
Minimum age: 21 years at the time of loan sanction.
Maximum age: 60 years for corporate employees (subject to retirement age).
Loan tenure must terminate on or before attaining age 60 or superannuation/retirement, whichever is earlier.
PAN validation and Aadhaar OTP based e-KYC and e-signing via YONO app.
Salaried employees having salary account with SBI.
Employees of Central/State Government, Armed Forces, Paramilitary, Railways, CPSEs, and Corporate Salary Package tie-ups.
Government/Defence Sector employees: minimum 6 months of continuous service.
Corporate Sector employees: minimum 12 months in present company.
Minimum Net Monthly Income (NMI) for Government/Defence employees: Rs. 20,000.
Minimum Net Monthly Income (NMI) for Corporate employees: Rs. 25,000.
Cash salary not eligible; regular credit into SBI Salary Package Account is mandatory.

source_title: SBI Personal Loan Interest Rates Matrix
raw_quote: Credit score cutoff benchmark 650; risk premium added for scores below 750.

source_title: SBI Personal Loan Interest Rates Matrix
raw_quote: Applicants with CIBIL score of 750 and above receive lowest published spread over 2-year MCLR.
Minimum Loan amount: Rs. 1 lakh.
Maximum loan amount: up to Rs. 50 Lakhs under Real-Time Xpress Credit.
Repayment Period: 6 months to 84 months.
Maximum repayment tenure: up to 84 months (7 years).
Interest rate is floating type pegged to the 2-Year Marginal Cost of Funds Based Lending Rate (MCLR).
Starting effective interest rate: 11.15% p.a. (spread of 2.40% over 2-year MCLR for Defence/Govt package).
Ceiling interest rate: up to 15.30% p.a. for standard corporate employees with lower credit scores.
Processing fee: Up to 1.50% of the loan amount (minimum Rs. 1,000 and maximum Rs. 15,000, plus applicable GST).
Nil prepayment penalty or foreclosure charges on floating rate personal loans per RBI regulatory directions.
Loan amount subject to EMI/NMI ratio up to 65% for defense/government employees.

how_derived: Inferred from public EMI affordability thresholds where standard corporate salaries below Rs 50k are capped at 50% EMI/NMI ratio.
raw_quote: Implied EMI/NMI ratio cap of 50% for standard corporate salary tier.
Maximum loan amount subject to 30-times Net Monthly Income (NMI) and EMI/NMI ratio, whichever is lower.
Sanction of loan is subject to bank internal credit appraisal and discretionary risk assessment.
